title: Crochet Smiling Cookie Keychain
name: Smiling Cookie
seoTitle: Crochet Smiling Cookie Keychain Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet smiling cookie keychain pattern: two round cookies with a cream layer, popcorn hands and feet and a happy face. Printable PDF download.
lead: A sandwich cookie with a big smile. Two flat circles hold a cream layer, and the arms and legs end in little popcorn-stitch hands and feet.
yarn: Cotton yarn in brown, white, pink and black

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in brown (cookie), white (cream and eyes), pink (hands and feet), black

notes: Popcorn (4 dc): 4 dc in the same place, take the hook out, insert it in the first dc and pull the loop through.

rounds.text: Magic ring, ch 2, 12 dc in the ring, sl st.
After round 2: ch 1 and sl st in the next st. Repeat (ch 1, sl st in next st) to the end.
Insert pink yarn into the 1st and 2nd ch and work a 4-dc popcorn for a cute hand or foot.
5 sc in a magic ring, sl st. Add a small black dot with black yarn.

finishing: Add the keyring at the top.
